features: Multipurpose Plastic Woven Storage Bins: When it comes to organization, our plastic basket organizer bins are excellent for home or office use. They're also fantastic as an organizer bin for shelves, closets, kitchen, bathroom, and even for your fridge! With its woven basket design, this multiuse plastic bin can add style to your overall house. Explore the possibilities of organizing with our versatile plastic basket organizer.

Durable and Sturdy Bins: Our storage bins are constructed of well-made and sturdy plastic material, superb for storing anything from toys to clothes. Their durable construction and mesh design provide additional strength, while their wide opening makes searching for items more manageable. These rectangular plastic bins can hold a lot of stuff for storage or your next camping trip.

Portable Baskets: THE BLOSSOM COLLECTION containers are the optimal solution for organizing your supplies and other household items. The plastic baskets easily be stacked when not in use for maximum space utilization. They are not only functional; they are also stylish decorative storage that comes in a wide selection of colors that can complement any furnishings.

Handy Basket with Handle: We’re all about creating simple solutions. Our storage bins have built-in side handles so they are easy to lift, slide, and move from one spot to another —even when fully loaded. Designed for easy grip and long-lasting durability, they add functionality by providing storage spaces for a variety of items.

Well-sized Woven Storage Basket: From snack storage in the kitchen to tool storage in the garage and everything in between, you can use BINO's storage baskets to store anything. Available in a wide range of colors - white, black, and grey, this organization system makes your space as beautiful as it is useful. This Medium Basket measures 10" x 8" x 4".
